title: X Mob Core
name: x_mob_core
short_description: A smooth, lightweight mob framework that powers smart creatures, animal packs, and tactical combat without slowing down your server.
long_description:
**X Mob Core** is a modern foundation and developer toolkit for creating living, intelligent creatures in Luanti.

> ⚠️ **Note**: This is an engine library for developers and server owners—it **does not include any mobs on its own**. To see creatures in your world, pair it with a mob pack like [x_mobs](https://content.luanti.org/packages/SaKeL/x_mobs/) or use it to build your own!

### Why Choose X Mob Core for Your Worlds?

- ⚡ **Built for Smooth, Lag-Free Play**: Traditional mob engines can quickly slow servers down when lots of creatures spawn or many players explore at once. X Mob Core is built from the ground up to be featherlight and lightning-fast, keeping your world running smoothly with high frame rates and responsive gameplay.
- 🐟 **Creatures That Act Like Real Animals**: Instead of isolated mobs walking into walls, creatures behave naturally together. Fish swim in synchronized schools, flying creatures flock and dive through the skies, and wolf or goblin packs follow their leaders, rally allies to their aid, and choose a new leader if their captain falls.
- ⚔️ **Exciting, Tactical Combat**: Battles feel lively and dynamic. Ranged enemies predict your movement rather than firing blindly, clever mobs back off to catch their breath and heal when injured, and strikes deliver clear visual feedback with overhead health bars, impact bursts, and immersive status effects like burning or web entanglements.
- 📦 **Zero Hassle, Zero Extra Mods**: Everything works out of the box with zero external dependencies. You don't need to hunt down five different helper mods just to get your creatures running.
- 🛠️ **A Joy for Modders to Create With**: Built by developers for developers. Whether you want to add a simple forest deer, a coordinated army of goblins, or an epic multi-phase boss, X Mob Core handles the heavy lifting—physics, pathfinding, sounds, and spawning—so you can focus on making fun gameplay.

> [!WARNING]
> ContendDB is enforcing AI labels unfairly.  Don't be misled by their AI labels. Based on their knowledge of AI, the time at which your code is committed or the commit message can cause the entire package to be labelled as AI-generated.
>
> [!NOTE]
> **AI Disclosure (Assisted)**: Core logic, gameplay mechanics, and all media assets (textures, 3D models, audio) are 100% human-authored without generative AI. AI tools are used solely for auxiliary productivity—such as documentation drafting, commit formatting, and test scaffolding. All code is manually tested and verified by the maintainer.
